bitcoin_articles.headline: Jazz Pharmaceuticals' ZIIHERA Receives Regulatory Approvals for Biliary Tract Cancer
bitcoin_articles.summary: Jazz Pharmaceuticals' drug ZIIHERA (zanidatamab-hrii) has been granted accelerated approval in the U.S. and conditional marketing authorization in the European Union for the treatment of eligible biliary tract cancer (BTC) patients.

bitcoin_articles.headline: BitGo Migrates Wrapped Bitcoin (WBTC) to Chainlink CCIP
bitcoin_articles.summary: BitGo has migrated its Wrapped Bitcoin (WBTC) to the Chainlink Cross-Chain Interoperability Protocol (CCIP) to enhance cross-chain functionality.
